#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# Causal Inference Analysis Script
# Load required packages
library(dagitty)
library(data.table)

# Read data
cat("Loading data...\n")
data <- fread("/app/data.csv")
cat("Data dimensions:", dim(data), "\n")
cat("Variables:", names(data), "\n")

# Read DAG specification
cat("Loading DAG specification...\n")
dag_text <- readLines("/app/dag.txt")
dag_text <- paste(dag_text, collapse = "\n")
cat("DAG specification:\n")
cat(dag_text, "\n")

# Parse DAG
dag <- dagitty(dag_text)
cat("Parsed DAG:\n")
print(dag)

# Define treatment and outcome
treatment <- "T"
outcome <- "Y"

# Find all minimal adjustment sets for T -> Y
cat("\nFinding minimal adjustment sets for", treatment, "->", outcome, "...\n")
adjustment_sets <- adjustmentSets(dag, exposure = treatment, outcome = outcome, type = "minimal")
cat("Found", length(adjustment_sets), "minimal adjustment set(s):\n")

# Save adjustment sets to file
output_file <- "/app/adjustment_sets.txt"
cat("\nSaving adjustment sets to", output_file, "...\n")
if (length(adjustment_sets) > 0) {
  # Convert adjustment sets to character representation
  set_strings <- sapply(adjustment_sets, function(x) {
    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return("")
    } else {
      return(paste(sort(x), collapse = ", "))
    }
  })
  
  # Write to file (one per line)
  writeLines(set_strings, output_file)
  cat("Adjustment sets saved.\n")
  
  # Print adjustment sets
  for (i in seq_along(adjustment_sets)) {
    cat("Set", i, ":", if(length(adjustment_sets[[i]]) == 0) "empty" else paste(sort(adjustment_sets[[i]]), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  # Use the first non-empty adjustment set for ATE estimation
  # If first set is empty, look for a non-empty one
  adj_set_idx <- 1
  if (length(adjustment_sets[[1]]) == 0 && length(adjustment_sets) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:length(adjustment_sets)) {
      if (length(adjustment_sets[[i]]) > 0) {
        adj_set_idx <- i
        break
      }
    }
  }
  
  adj_set <- adjustment_sets[[adj_set_idx]]
  cat("\nUsing adjustment set", adj_set_idx, "for ATE estimation:", 
      if(length(adj_set) == 0) "empty (no adjustment needed)" else paste(adj_set, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Estimate ATE using linear regression
  if (length(adj_set) == 0) {
    # No adjustment needed - simple difference in means
    formula_str <- paste(outcome, "~", treatment)
  } else {
    # Adjust for covariates
    formula_str <- paste(outcome, "~", treatment, "+", paste(adj_set, collapse = " + "))
  }
  
  cat("Fitting model:", formula_str, "\n")
  model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = data)
  
  # Extract ATE (coefficient for treatment)
  ate <- coef(model)[treatment]
  cat("Estimated ATE (coefficient for", treatment, "):", ate, "\n")
  
  # Save ATE to file
  ate_file <- "/app/ate_result.txt"
  cat("Saving ATE to", ate_file, "...\n")
  writeLines(as.character(ate), ate_file)
  cat("ATE saved.\n")
  
} else {
  cat("No adjustment sets found!\n")
  # Write empty file for adjustment sets
  writeLines("", "/app/adjustment_sets.txt")
  
  # Try simple regression without adjustment
  cat("Attempting simple regression without adjustment...\n")
  formula_str <- paste(outcome, "~", treatment)
  model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = data)
  ate <- coef(model)[treatment]
  cat("Estimated ATE (simple regression):", ate, "\n")
  
  # Save ATE to file
  writeLines(as.character(ate), "/app/ate_result.txt")
}

# Additional diagnostics
cat("\n=== Model Summary ===\n")
print(summary(model))

cat("\n=== Checking for descendants of treatment or outcome ===\n")
# Get all variables in DAG
all_vars <- names(data)

# Check if adjustment sets contain descendants
if (length(adjustment_sets) > 0 && length(adj_set) > 0) {
  # Get descendants of treatment and outcome
  treat_descendants <- descendants(dag, treatment)
  outcome_descendants <- descendants(dag, outcome)
  
  cat("Descendants of treatment (", treatment, "):", treat_descendants, "\n")
  cat("Descendants of outcome (", outcome, "):", outcome_descendants, "\n")
  
  # Check if any variable in adjustment set is a descendant
  for (var in adj_set) {
    if (var %in% treat_descendants) {
      cat("Warning: Variable", var, "in adjustment set is a descendant of treatment!\n")
    }
    if (var %in% outcome_descendants) {
      cat("Warning: Variable", var, "in adjustment set is a descendant of outcome!\n")
    }
  }
}
